newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Loctite shares rise.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Loctite shares rise.

text.p: Shares of Loctite Corp climbed after hours on Wednesday after Henkel KGaA raised its offer to buy the company for $61 per share.
Loctite's stock rose 1-1/8 to 61-1/2 in after-hours trading. During market hours, the shares had climbed 1/8 to unofficially close at 60-3/8.
Henkel, a German chemicals group that already owns a 35 percent stake in adhesives maker Loctite, initially offered $57.75 per share.
Traders said no other shares moved significantly from their closing prices.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 24,200 shares compared with 33,900 shares on Tuesday. Session two volume was 4,511,900 shares compared with 462,900 shares on Tuesday.
